decisions.reason: Three real CVEs in Apache Syncope identity management: SQL injection (CVE-2026-82232), Groovy sandbox bypass (CVE-2026-77147), JWT session hijack (CVE-2026-73178). Affects 3.0.x, 4.0.x, 4.1.x. Fixes in 4.0.8 and 4.1.3.
TP-Link Tapo C200 auth bypass and DoS (CVE-2026-15315, CVE-2026-15316) discovered by OPSWAT. Patched in firmware V5_1.4.6. IoT device with network-accessible attack surface.
Chinese-speaking threat actors actively using Noodle RAT (ANGRYREBEL) for cross-platform espionage on Windows and Linux. Ongoing campaign, not a new disclosure.

HPE EdgeConnect SD-WAN advisory with 40 vulns including CVSS 9.9 and 9.8 auth bypass flaws (CVE-2026-76669, CVE-2026-76670, CVE-2026-76673, CVE-2026-76684). Unauthenticated admin takeover possible. Critical infrastructure networking gear.
CenterPoint Energy confirmed breach via SEC 8-K filing. Unauthorized party accessed customer PII through external-facing system. Houston-based utility, significant customer base.
Smishing Triad (Outsider sub-cluster) running large-scale SMS phishing with JWR kit. Steals payment cards, OTPs, bank credentials, digital wallet logins. PaaS ecosystem operation.
CVE-2026-90894 'ParaShells' - local privilege escalation in Parallels Desktop allowing unprivileged macOS user to gain root on host. Disclosed by JFrog. Affects widely-used virtualization software.
Bruce Schneier highlighting new variant of CAPTCHA-framed social engineering scam. Users tricked into downloading malware disguised as CAPTCHA verification. Active scam technique.
CERT Polska report on 6 vulnerabilities in WNC T-Mobile 5G Box IDU routers (CVE-2026-58146, CVE-2026-58147, CVE-2026-40854-40857). Firmware-level flaws in consumer carrier equipment.
Chrome 153 update patches 42 vulns including 3 critical memory bugs. Major browser update with critical RCE-class fixes.

CVE-2026-84869 in ConnectWise ScreenConnect actively exploited per CISA KEV. Missing authorization allows file transfer and execution without auth. Patched in 26.6.5. Over 1,000 unpatched instances exposed. Fourth ScreenConnect vuln flagged by CISA since 2024.

decisions.story_title: Acronis Patches Actively Exploited cPanel Privilege Escalation
decisions.reason: CVE-2026-87886, local privilege escalation in Acronis cPanel plugin, CVSS 7.8, actively exploited in wild. Patches released.
AI-generated npm password stealer with 9 detections and 25 IOCs. Operator used stolen credentials for fake bug bounty payouts. Notable for AI-assisted malware development trend.
Ransomware attack on Avelogic SmartHRMS platform compromising payroll system. Targeted SaaS HR platform affects multiple downstream organizations.
Eclipse Jetty has 82 CVEs, 7 critical/high, max CVSS 10, 92% unpatched. Trust score C. Widely embedded Java web server, no CISA KEV yet but large attack surface.
